design:
## Design tests

Revision 37 and the redrawn cast were read blind in whole test scenes among other events (`vision/design_tests_v039.md`, five pictures in two rounds, five readers), three of them asking for an animal turned from profile. The catch read one way: "the ball sits just after the top of the arc, so it reads as heading down toward the girl", where v0.38's could run from either end. The turned dogs read as in profile, begging at 45 and bowing at 45. The summer heaps took the season out of the remark but not the remark: two readers of two asked where leaves came from under green trees, more softly than in v0.38. The goat at 135 was the picture's strangest thing, "a lumpy brown shape that looks more like a sack or blanket on its back than a goat's body", so its coat went back to the bench; drawn white and rebuilt on the same seed, it was "a white goat with grey curved horns" that "reads clearly as a grazing goat".
intro:
The thirty-sixth screen read all 96 pictures, the set's 21 and 75 probes, twelve readers and four scorers: 1025 of 1030 scored items had full marks, and none was misread. All 64 templates pass the gate, the set's 287 items all at 1.00, and every (template, angle) the animals are drawn at passes on its own in two or more pictures. The man in red is read as a man in all 17 of his pictures, the catch names its thrower in all three, and the goat is no longer a sack. Read strictly, the full marks the scorers themselves called hedged would leave 63 of 64 through, `windy_hat` the one under; v0.40's list starts there and with the summer heaps' green leaves.

With the cast redrawn no picture could be identical to v0.38's. On the 7 with the same seed and events in both screens, each drawn in its own cast, all 75 items scored the same.
screen:
Across all 96 pictures 1025 of 1030 scored items had full marks, and none was misread. The four scorers gave two, two, none and one items under full marks, in 282, 246, 269 and 233, all on probes: a small girl's ice cream at the back of two goat probes, "something small and pink"; the dog at the door, which wants "to go for a walk or wants to go inside"; the man sweeping with the giant fork, read as "scraping or digging at a small pile of dirt"; and the clouds of the windy park, a setting item. The set's headline is all items 1.00 (0.998 in v0.38), every type at 1.00.

**What the full marks rest on.** Two scorers listed 11 items they credited in full where the free description commits and the unsure section adds another reading (23 in v0.38). Halved, 63 of 64 templates pass, and `windy_hat` falls to 0.889, as one reader again offers "throwing her hands up in alarm".

**The angles.** The keys list each picture's animals with their angle, and the scorers tagged 13 oddities about animals with it: 6 of the 44 drawn in profile, 4 of the 25 at three-quarter front and 3 of the 4 at three-quarter back. The goat has 10 of the 13 (its head lost in the grass tuft, out of place in a park or garden, once "thin and angular") and none concerns how a turned animal reads.

**Remarks were 3.10 a picture, 298 on 96 pictures**, from 2.62 to 4.00 a reader. The summer heaps drew a new form of the old remark in five pictures from four readers: "Some of the raked leaves are green rather than brown or autumn-coloured, which looks a little odd for raked fallen leaves".
redrawn: The catch, `play_catch`, ruled with the ball short of the catcher's hands, holds at 1.00 and loses its hedge (0.75 read strictly in v0.38). The heaps, `sweep` and `rake`, drawn for summer, hold at 1.00. The eight templates whose animals now turn all hold at 1.00, and so does every angle of each. `ice_cream_drop`, v0.38's lowest, goes from 0.96 to 1.00, the dog at the splat in all four pictures.
gate: Every template was screened in at least three pictures (41 in three, 10 in four, 6 in five, 4 in six, 1 in seven, 1 in eleven and 1 in twenty), and all 64 pass, as in v0.34, v0.36 and v0.38. The lowest are `dog_wants_walk` (0.917) and `sweep_fork` (0.944), each on one half mark, and `ice_cream` (0.95) on two. Per angle (`vision/v039/gate_yaw.json`), all 17 (template, angle) pairs pass at 1.00. The gate is a filter, and the pilot with people is the test of difficulty.
inspection: The tier-1 to tier-3 cells all placed in the showcase pass under revision 37 and the redrawn cast, eight of them with other events than v0.38's and four with the same. The tier-4 garden and park placed again on v0.38's seeds with the same events, and the street on v0.29 to v0.38's forced set. The playground's seed and the next 39 of its search placed nothing; the 41st did, with a ball in the tree and a perched bird for v0.38's kite and flying bird. The five isomorphs draw an animal whose template their partner shares at the partner's angle. The probes stratified by angle found the dog walked on a lead never placed at 45: in 12 tries in four settings its lead crossed its back on the way to the collar at every one of 1893 curves, which revision 12 forbids, so the angle is dropped and drawn at 90, the draw kept so that the other records rebuild as they were. Two garden probes that had drawn it in failed tries rebuilt on earlier seeds. Every picture was looked at before the screen. All 96 records rebuild identical to the pixel, and the library passes the validator in full, 391 of 391.
calib: With the cast redrawn and the animals turned, 34 fields of the calibration moved by 0.002 or more, the most the dog's paint tracks' inference salience (by 0.064), so the priors are v0.39's own.
